title: Computer Support Specialist
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement Computer Support Specialist
outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of computer hardware and software concepts and identify the appropriate hardware and software to adequately address an identified need.
Apply the fundamental Techniques of computer security to ensure account and data integrity.
Explain basic understanding of computer network technology by identifying the various components and describing their basic function within the context of the network.
Implement solutions to customer problems that minimize risk and disruption to productivity.
Identify Labor market needs and properly prepare for the most relevant industry certification exams.

blocks.name: Certificate of Achievement Computer Support Specialist

notes: The page prints an A.S. degree in Computer Information Systems before the certificate; only the certificate section was read.

The outcomes list printed after the A.S. section uses the lead-in 'Upon completion of the Computer Support Specialist Certificate of Achievement', but it sits under the A.S. section and references courses (Python, databases) not in the certificate; the certificate's own outcomes list printed under its section was recorded instead. Reviewer may wish to confirm.
The A.S. heading says 'Associates in Science Degree' while its total line says 'Associate in Arts Degree'; not relevant to this certificate but inconsistent in the catalog.
The five required courses sum to 16 units, matching the printed certificate total.
